# Game Theorist **Model the other player's next move before you make yours.** A dialogue-driven game theory skill for negotiation, pricing, fundraising, partnerships and competition. [![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-1.0.0-111111)](./.claude-plugin/plugin.json) [![Licence](https://img.shields.io/badge/licence-MIT-2E7D32)](./LICENSE) [![CI](https://img.shields.io/badge/CI-GitHub%20Actions-2088FF?logo=githubactions&logoColor=white)](./.github/workflows/validate.yml)
## See the board Game Theorist is for decisions where another person, company, regulator or coalition can react. It does not give a strategy until the players, incentives, available moves and likely response are visible.

Prisoner's Dilemma
Stag Hunt
Chicken
## Try it Invoke `/game-theorist` or describe a strategic situation: ```text I need to negotiate a job offer. They offered $155K. I am currently at $148K. They seem excited, but say the budget is tight. ``` The skill opens with one question, then works through one phase at a time: ```text Describe the situation in 2-3 sentences. Who are the players, and what is at stake? ``` See the [complete salary negotiation](./demos/salary-negotiation-transcript.md), where the model maps the recruiter's incentives, tests the claimed salary cap and adapts after the counter-offer. ## Contract | Signal | Behaviour | |---|---| | Use when | Another actor's strategic response can change the decision | | Produces | A six-phase model, a concrete recommendation and a self-contained HTML artefact | | Interaction | One question or phase at a time, with user confirmation between phases | | Refuses | Pure calculations, drafting, definitions, root-cause analysis and one-person yes/no decisions | | Source of truth | [`skills/game-theorist/SKILL.md`](./skills/game-theorist/SKILL.md) | ## The six phases ```mermaid flowchart LR S[Situation] --> Q[Opening question] Q --> P1[1. Deconstruction] P1 --> P2[2. Incentives] P2 --> P3[3. Strategy space] P3 --> P4[4. Equilibrium] P4 --> P5[5. Recommendation] P5 --> P6[6. Adaptation] P6 --> A[HTML artefact] ``` 1. **Deconstruction:** identify players, timing, information and the type of game. 2. **Incentive mapping:** separate stated objectives from revealed incentives, constraints and outside options. 3. **Strategy space:** enumerate credible moves and remove dominated strategies. 4. **Equilibrium:** test which outcomes remain stable when each player can deviate. 5. **Recommendation:** choose one move, make it credible and define contingencies. 6. **Dynamic adaptation:** update the model when the other side responds or new information appears. The recommendation is a structured hypothesis, not a promise. Missing players, incomplete information, reputation and regulatory options remain explicit analysis risks. ## Install ### Claude Code ```bash claude plugin marketplace add saltandsilicon/game-theorist claude plugin install game-theorist@game-theorist ``` ### Codex, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline and other compatible agents ```bash npx skills add saltandsilicon/game-theorist -a codex npx skills add saltandsilicon/game-theorist -a cursor npx skills add saltandsilicon/game-theorist -a windsurf npx skills add saltandsilicon/game-theorist -a cline npx skills add saltandsilicon/game-theorist ``` ### Manual Markdown import ```bash git clone https://github.com/saltandsilicon/game-theorist.git cp -r game-theorist/skills/game-theorist ~/.claude/skills/ ``` ## Examples and references | Resource | What it contains | |---|---| | [Salary negotiation](./demos/salary-negotiation-transcript.md) | A complete six-phase conversation | | [Wrong-call correction](./demos/wrong-call-correction-transcript.md) | A case where the model must revise its first read | | [Worked examples](./examples/worked-examples.md) | Condensed strategic cases across business situations | | [Edge cases](./examples/edge-cases.md) | Boundaries and ambiguous activation cases | | [Frameworks](./docs/frameworks.md) | The analytical methods used across the phases | | [Resources](./docs/resources.md) | Books, papers, courses and tools | ## Source and distribution ```text skills/game-theorist/SKILL.md | +--> Claude Code plugin +--> Codex and compatible agent installers +--> generated Cursor and Windsurf copies ``` Edit [`skills/game-theorist/SKILL.md`](./skills/game-theorist/SKILL.md). Do not edit `.cursor/` or `.windsurf/` directly; GitHub Actions generates those copies from the source skill. ## Verify a change ```bash python3 scripts/validate.py ``` The validator checks the skill frontmatter, both Claude plugin manifests and version alignment. It requires PyYAML for frontmatter parsing: ```bash pip install pyyaml ``` The automated validator does not run a complete six-phase conversation. Before opening a pull request, test one real situation in a supported assistant and confirm that the skill waits between phases. ## Contributing Read [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](./CONTRIBUTING.md) before changing the skill. Contributions should sharpen a real strategic failure mode, framework or example. Open pull requests against `main` and include one applied example when adding a framework. ## Licence Game Theorist is available under the [MIT Licence](./LICENSE).
